_readme: OPTIONAL: ClinePass key-router provider entry for the factory user's ~/.pi/agent/models.json (merge under 'providers'). CRPASS_UPSTREAM must carry the /api prefix (api.cline.bot/api). BILLING: the model id's first path segment selects the program — ids like 'cline-pass/glm-5.3-flash' bill the ClinePass weekly limit; bare vendor ids from the catalog ('z-ai/…', 'deepseek/…') bill pay-as-you-go Cline Credits instead. Reasoning models need a sane max_tokens (tiny caps return 500 'empty response content'). host.docker.internal must resolve on the HOST (the pi-factory-setup skill adds 127.0.0.1 host.docker.internal to /etc/hosts) and via host-gateway inside containers (fallback mode adds it; compose mode uses extra_hosts). The keyrouter (src/keyrouter.ts, port 8099) fans your ClinePass API keys (state/clinepass.keys, one per line, live-reloaded) behind a single endpoint. The keyrouter injects reasoning_effort into chat/completions bodies that omit it — default 'low', tunable via CRPASS_REASONING_EFFORT on the keyrouter unit (low/medium/high/max); per-request values override — the pass pool's models otherwise emit enormous hidden reasoning that turns simple stage calls into hour-long hangs.
